name: 53963 · Waupun, WI
findings: ZIP 53963 (Waupun) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53963 (Waupun) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
39% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53963 (Waupun) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 53% of all organizations here have no identified type.
